description: ab-tao hooks：檔案保護、危險命令攔截、macOS 通知

hooks.command: FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$FILE" ] && exit 0; for p in '.env' '.env.local' '.env.production' 'package-lock.json' 'pnpm-lock.yaml' 'yarn.lock' 'composer.lock' 'Podfile.lock'; do [[ "$FILE" == *"$p"* ]] && { echo "Blocked: $FILE is protected" >&2; exit 2; }; done; exit 0

CMD=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.command // empty' 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$CMD" ] && exit 0; for p in 'rm -rf /' 'git push --force main' 'git push --force master' 'git reset --hard' 'DROP TABLE' 'DROP DATABASE' 'curl.*|.*bash' 'curl.*|.*sh' 'wget.*|.*bash' 'wget.*|.*sh' 'eval.*base64'; do echo "$CMD" | grep -qiE "$p" && { echo "Blocked: dangerous command detected: $p" >&2; exit 2; }; done; exit 0
osascript -e 'display notification "Context 即將自動壓縮，長對話記憶可能縮短" with title "ab-tao"' 2>/dev/null; exit 0
